description.value: A Soowahlie First Nation campground nestled between Sweltzer Creek and the Vedder River under old-growth cedar, with a family atmosphere and flush facilities; access is via a short downhill gravel road, and the site runs May through Labour Day only.

address.value: 4745 Sleepy Hollow Road, Cultus Lake, V2R4Y2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is available and confirms key details: address matches OSM exactly, tent sites and electrical sites are confirmed, and amenities such as showers, potable water (5 taps), and a gazebo are explicitly listed. The site content appears frozen at 2023 season-opening announcements (phone line issues, patience requested), raising currency concerns, but OSM flags looks_closed=false. No hiker/biker-specific sites, laundry, tools, fuel, or cyclist discount are mentioned anywhere.
concerns: Website content appears frozen at 2023 season-opening announcements; it is unclear whether it has been updated since. Business currency cannot be fully verified.
Website reported an active phone line outage during 2023; the OSM phone number (+1-604-824-4023) could not be confirmed via website content.
Website explicitly notes Google Maps directions lead to a gated community — correct routing requires following on-site directions.
Website confirms no WiFi available for campers ('At this time we do NOT have wifi for our campers').
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate campground with tent sites, showers, potable water, and a gazebo in a scenic creekside location near Cultus Lake — a useful stopover for touring cyclists on the Fraser Valley route.
enrichment_extras.notes: Campground is owned and operated by the Soowahlie First Nation. Season runs May through September (to Labour Day weekend). Electrical sites are available per website amenities list.

wow_evidence: Soowahlie First Nation campground nestled between Sweltzer Creek and the Vedder River under old-growth cedar
